verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents Terraform encrypting state at rest. The docs only recommend storing state in HCP Terraform or a remote backend to 'securely store state', which is an adjacent storage arrangement rather than a documented encryption feature. A community report also says secrets are stored unencrypted in state, so the axis applies but is not delivered.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can encrypt state at rest so credentials and sensitive values are not readable in plaintext state files
